title: movement
summary: MSUI ports MovementInfo byte-for-byte and handles the local MSG_MOVE stream including START/STOP_SWIM plus pitch, teleport, the complete force-speed family, all four granted modes, the full 21-opcode inbound relay family, compressed relay batches, and both six-kind observer speed families. Remote players interpolate while retaining reported aim; stop/turn/land edges snap. SPLINE_SET updates live paths and MOVE_SET applies fresh pose then speed. Observer forms never ack; a controlled self-addressed relay takes the dedicated hard-snap/no-ack path while free-view and non-controlled session bodies remain observers.

openItems.text: SMSG_FORCE_{RUN,RUN_BACK,SWIM,SWIM_BACK,WALK}_SPEED_CHANGE / SMSG_FORCE_TURN_RATE_CHANGE not handled and no CMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE_ACK senders (vmangos expects the ack echo; a mount/buff speed change goes unacknowledged)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The complete six-kind force-speed family is opcode-mapped, strictly parsed, applied to entity/control state, and acknowledged using Benilla's exact full-guid, counter, MovementInfo, speed body.

openItems.text: Move-mode grants SMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK/LAND_WALK, SMSG_MOVE_FEATHER_FALL/NORMAL_FALL, SMSG_MOVE_SET_HOVER/UNSET_HOVER not handled; CMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK_ACK, CMSG_MOVE_FEATHER_FALL_ACK, CMSG_MOVE_HOVER_ACK never sent
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: All six water-walk/land-walk, feather/normal-fall and set/unset-hover SMSGs parse packed GUID plus counter, update persistent mover state, and send the exact live-pose ack with trailing apply dword.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPLINE_SET_* speed packets (non-controlled movers) not handled
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: All six SMSG_SPLINE_SET_* bodies strict-decode [packed guid][f32 speed], and all six MSG_MOVE_SET_* bodies strict-decode [packed guid][MovementInfo][f32 speed]. Both update the addressed entity speed set without ack; MOVE_SET additionally applies its fresh remote-player pose. Focused and full clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Inbound MSG_MOVE_* relays for other players have no dispatch case in Program.Net.cs - Entities.ApplyRemotePlayerMove exists but has no caller
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: MovementRelayPackets defines and strict-decodes Benilla's exact 21 rebroadcast opcodes as [packed guid][MovementInfo]. GameLoop.Net dispatches them to EntityStore.ApplyRemotePlayerMove with self/controlled-mover exclusion. The clinical fixture proves packed GUID/tails, malformed rejection, sparse-position interpolation, authoritative facing and stop snapping; focused and full suites pass.

openItems.text: Live-verify another player walking, running, strafing, backpedaling, turning, jumping, swimming and stopping: motion should remain smooth between relays, facing should follow reported aim rather than travel tangent, and no self/possessed-body correction should occur.

Live-verify nearby creature and player walk/run/run-back/swim/swim-back/turn-rate changes, including mounting and mid-spline haste: gait thresholds and interpolation speed should update immediately, MOVE_SET should consume its fresh pose, and no observer ack should be emitted.
